questions.question: Who is the owner of the post "Eliciting priors from experts"?
questions.evidence: "Eliciting priors from experts" is the Title of post; owner refers to DisplayName
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

questions.question: Which post by slashnick has the most answers count? State the post ID.
questions.evidence: most answers count refers to MAX(AnswerCount); post by slashnick refers to DisplayName = 'slashnick';
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.PostId FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'slashnick' ORDER BY T3.AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Give the user's reputation and up vote number of the user that commented "fine, you win :)".
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Reputation, T2.UpVotes FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Text = 'fine, you win :)'

questions.question: How many views did the post titled 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer' get?
questions.evidence: "Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer" is the Title of post; views refers to ViewCount
questions.SQL: SELECT ViewCount FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

questions.question: Among the users located in United Kingdom, how many users whose post have a total favorite amount of 4 or more?
questions.evidence: favorite amount of 4 or more refers to FavoriteCount > = 4; Location = 'United Kingdom';
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.Location = 'United Kingdom' AND T2.FavoriteCount >= 4

questions.question: What is the excerpt post ID and wiki post ID of the tag named sample?
questions.evidence: tag named sample refers to TagName = 'sample';
questions.SQL: SELECT ExcerptPostId, WikiPostId FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'sample'

questions.question: Which user have only one post history per post and having at least 1000 views?
questions.evidence: having at least 1000 view refers to Views > = 1000; user refers to UserId
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.UserId FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T3.ViewCount >= 1000 GROUP BY T2.UserId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.PostHistoryTypeId) = 1
